inicio.subtitulo: Operational summary of the registered SQL Server instances.
inicio.vacio.texto: There are no instances registered in this environment yet. Once the first one is registered, its status and alerts will show up here.
ingreso.ayuda: Sign in with Google or with email and password, always with two-factor authentication.
presentacion.descripcion: DBA Assistant manages and monitors SQL Server instances with artificial intelligence: natural-language queries, alerts with their remediation and changes rehearsed in a Sandbox.
presentacion.titulo: Your SQL Server databases, under control and in plain language
presentacion.subtitulo: DBA Assistant turns your questions into safe T-SQL, monitors your instances in real time and suggests the right remediation for every incident, with full traceability of every action.
presentacion.form.ayuda: Each company has its own address. If you do not know it, ask your company's Administrator.
presentacion.form.no_existe: We could not find an enabled company at that address. Check it or ask your company's Administrator.
presentacion.invitado: Were you invited to add your company?
presentacion.demo.pedido: How many active customers have overdue balances?
presentacion.demo.remediacion: Suggested remediation: shrink the transaction log
presentacion.funciones.titulo: Everything a DBA needs, in one place
presentacion.funciones.subtitulo: Built for database teams and for people who need data without writing SQL.
presentacion.funciones.chat.texto: Ask in plain words and get the T-SQL and the result, with sensitive columns masked and CSV export.
presentacion.funciones.monitoreo.texto: Sessions, blocking, deadlocks, CPU, memory, space, backups, SQL Server Agent jobs and Query Store, in real time.
presentacion.funciones.alertas.texto: Thresholds and events that notify by push and email, with the suggested remediation ready to run, from your phone too.
presentacion.funciones.sandbox.texto: Rehearse changes on a replica of the structure, inside a transaction that is rolled back, and promote them with a second factor.
presentacion.funciones.contexto.texto: Glossary, rules, sensitive tables and functional documents so the AI understands your data the way your team does.
presentacion.funciones.auditoria.texto: Every query, change and remediation is kept in logs for 5 years, exportable to CSV and PDF.
presentacion.pasos.1.texto: With the DBA Assistant team's invitation you choose your company address and become its first Administrator.
presentacion.pasos.2.texto: Register your SQL Server instances for DEV, TESTING and PROD and add your team with their role and per-environment permissions.
presentacion.pasos.3.texto: From your browser or your phone, with artificial intelligence as your assistant and every action audited.
presentacion.seguridad.subtitulo: Each company runs isolated and every sensitive action asks for an extra confirmation.
presentacion.seguridad.mfa: Mandatory second factor at sign-in, managed by Auth0.
presentacion.seguridad.prod: Actions on PROD are confirmed again with the second factor or a device passkey.
presentacion.seguridad.credenciales: Connection credentials are encrypted: they are never shown or sent to the browser.
presentacion.seguridad.roles: Roles and per-environment permissions: everyone does only what they should.
presentacion.seguridad.aislamiento: Each company has its own address and its own databases, isolated from the others.
presentacion.seguridad.bitacoras: Transaction, audit and exception logs for 5 years.
error.titulo: The operation could not be completed
admin.eyebrow: Admin panel · restricted to the Administrator role
admin.subtitulo: Company users, roles and enabled environments.
usuarios.confirmar_baja: The user will not be able to sign in. They can be reactivated for 30 days; after that they are deleted. Continue?
usuarios.confirmar_rol: Changing the role changes what the user can do in each environment; any restrictions are kept. Confirm the change?
usuarios.permisos.nota: Whatever the role does not allow is disabled: here permissions can only be removed, never extended. Changes apply from the user's next action.
usuarios.permisos.fuera_de_rol: Their role does not allow it
usuarios.creado_enviada: User created. We emailed the access notice to
usuarios.creado_sin_correo: User created. Outgoing email is not configured: give them this address to sign in:
usuarios.creado_fallida: User created, but the email could not be sent. Give them this address to sign in or resend the invitation:
usuarios.invitacion.asunto: You have access to DBA Assistant · {empresa}
conexiones.subtitulo: The company's SQL Server instances that the system manages and monitors.
conexiones.vacio: There are no connections registered yet. Register the first instance with “New connection” to start monitoring it.
conexiones.winrm_sin_servicios: WinRM connected, but no SQL Server services were found.
conexiones.mismo_servidor_ayuda: Two environments point to the same server: an action meant for one may affect the other.
conexiones.usa_sa_ayuda: We recommend a user with minimal permissions
conexiones.confirmar_eliminar: The connection and its credentials will be deleted. The logs are kept. Continue?
conexiones.confirmar_mfa: Deleting a PROD connection requires confirming with the second factor. This device's biometrics are used or, if it is not registered, the Auth0 screen. Continue?
conexiones.form.password_conservar: Leave empty to keep the current one
conexiones.form.windows_ayuda: Optional. Lets you view and start the SQL Server service when the engine is down.
conexiones.faltantes: Warning, the login is missing permissions: {permisos}.
conexiones.permiso.view_server_state: VIEW SERVER STATE (monitoring and Query Store)
conexiones.permiso.msdb_jobs: read access to the jobs in msdb (SQLAgentReaderRole and db_datareader roles)
conexiones.permiso.agente_crear: create and run jobs in msdb (SQLAgentOperatorRole role: scheduled backups and retries)
monitor.subtitulo: Engine health and performance in real time. Click a gauge to see its history.
monitor.vacio.titulo: There are no instances registered yet
monitor.vacio.texto: Monitoring starts automatically when an Administrator or DBA registers a connection.
monitor.sin_datos: There are no readings for this instance yet. The collector picks it up within 30 seconds.
monitor.obsoleto: The connection to the instance was lost (CON_DB_003). Showing the last known values, from {hora}.
monitor.serie.vacia: No data in the selected range.
monitor.serie.escalas: Scale relative to the range maximum —
monitor.config.ayuda: Disabled metrics are hidden. Thresholds color the gauges and drive the alerts; the critical value must be higher than the warning value. Leave both empty to skip thresholds.
monitor.config.politica_ayuda: Alerts when a database has no full backup within the period, or no log backup if its recovery model is FULL or BULK_LOGGED.
alertas.evento.instancia.descripcion: Unable to connect to {servidor} (CON_DB_003). The engine may be stopped or the network down.
alertas.evento.bloqueo.titulo: Sustained blocking for more than {segundos} s
alertas.evento.bloqueo.descripcion: Session {sid} blocked by session {bloqueador} for {espera} s ({recurso}). Sessions in this situation: {cantidad}.
alertas.evento.log.descripcion: The log of {base} is at {uso}%. Check the log backups or its growth.
alertas.evento.backup_full.descripcion: The last full backup of {base} was {tiempo} ago (the policy requires one every {plazo}).
alertas.evento.backup_full.nunca: {base} has no full backups in the last 40 days (the policy requires one every {plazo}).
alertas.evento.backup_log.descripcion: {base} uses the {recuperacion} recovery model and its last log backup was {tiempo} ago (the policy requires one every {plazo}). The log keeps growing until it is backed up.
alertas.evento.agente.descripcion: The SQL Server Agent service on {servidor} is {estado}: jobs and scheduled backups are not running.
alertas.evento.job.descripcion: The last run of {job} failed {tiempo} ago. {error}
alertas.evento.job_colgado.descripcion: {job} has been running for {tiempo}; it usually takes {promedio}.
alertas.subtitulo: Severities follow the configured thresholds and rules.
alertas.sin_activas: There are no active alerts: every monitored condition is within its thresholds.
alertas.sin_atendidas: There are no acknowledged alerts yet.
alertas.aviso_prod: You'll be asked to confirm and use MFA (PROD)
alertas.aviso_confirmacion: You'll be asked to confirm before it runs
alertas.reglas.ayuda: Besides these rules, the Monitoring thresholds and the fixed events (instance unreachable, database unavailable, blocking for more than 30 s and transaction log above 90%) raise alerts automatically.
alertas.reglas.vacio: There are no custom rules yet.
alertas.reglas.confirmar_eliminar: The rule «{nombre}» will be deactivated and its active alerts closed. The history is kept. Continue?
alertas.push.activado: Push notifications enabled on this device.
alertas.push.desactivado: Push notifications disabled on this device.
alertas.push.denegado: The browser is not allowed to show notifications.
alertas.push.no_soportado: This browser does not support push notifications.
alertas.push.sin_service_worker: The browser did not register the service worker (requires HTTPS with a trusted certificate).
alertas.confirmar_reactivar: «{titulo}» will raise alerts again if the condition is met. Continue?
alertas.atender.desestimar_ayuda: The alert is closed and this condition will not alert again on this instance while the dismissal is in effect. It can be reactivated from the Dismissed tab.
workarounds.aviso.autorizacion: {usuario} requests to run {workaround} on {conexion} outside the maintenance window. Reason: {motivo}
workarounds.aviso.no_realizada: Could not run {workaround} for alert A-{alerta}: {error}
conexiones.form.ventana_ayuda: Optional. Instance local time range in which heavy tasks (index rebuilds, statistics) are allowed without requesting authorization. It can span midnight.
workarounds.subtitulo: {cantidad} remediations. Built-in ones are ready to use; custom ones are validated in Sandbox before they are enabled for PROD. Only Administrators and DBAs create or edit them.
workarounds.vacio: No remediations match the selected filter. Try another category or clear the search.
workarounds.confirmar_eliminar: «{nombre}» will be deactivated. Its versions and executions are kept. Continue?
workarounds.detalle.pendiente_sandbox: The current version has not been validated in the Sandbox yet: it can run on DEV and TESTING; on PROD only the latest validated version runs.
workarounds.form.transaccional: Transactional: if a step fails, all of them are rolled back (uncheck if it uses KILL, SHRINK, BACKUP or other commands that do not support transactions).
workarounds.form.pasos: Steps (one T-SQL batch per step, run in order)
workarounds.form.ayuda_validacion: Before saving, the syntax is validated by compiling the steps (without running them) against an instance and database.
workarounds.ejecutar.sin_bloqueadores: No sessions are blocking others right now.
workarounds.ejecutar.raiz: ★ heads a blocking chain. Choose the sessions to terminate.
workarounds.ejecutar.aviso_backup_log: The log is waiting for a log backup: the shrink will free little until one is taken.
workarounds.ejecutar.sin_bases_caidas: All databases on the instance are ONLINE.
workarounds.ejecutar.base_no_recuperable: Only OFFLINE databases are brought ONLINE. SUSPECT, RECOVERY_PENDING or EMERGENCY need manual diagnosis (files, DBCC CHECKDB): forcing them can lose data.
workarounds.ejecutar.nada: There is nothing to do right now.
workarounds.ejecutar.ayuda_autorizacion: Outside the maintenance window, an Administrator or DBA must authorize it (it can be you, confirming with the second factor). Once authorized, you have 2 hours to run it.
workarounds.ejecutar.autorizacion_pedida: Authorization requested. Administrators and DBAs have been notified.
workarounds.ejecutar.confirmar_mfa: Running on PROD requires confirming with the second factor. This device's biometrics are used or, if it is not registered, the Auth0 screen. Continue?
workarounds.ejecutar.escribir_instancia: Type the instance name to confirm
workarounds.ejecutar.aviso_mfa: When you confirm, your second factor is requested: this device's biometrics or the authenticator code.
workarounds.ejecutar.sugerido_ventana: The start of the next maintenance window is suggested. It runs as a SQL Server Agent job that deletes itself when it succeeds.
workarounds.ejecutar.sugerido_sin_ventan: The connection has no maintenance window: 02:00 is suggested. It runs as a SQL Server Agent job that deletes itself when it succeeds.
workarounds.ejecutar.agente_detenido: SQL Server Agent is not running: the backup will not run until it is started.
workarounds.ejecutar.sin_jobs: There are no enabled jobs to retry.
workarounds.autorizaciones.ayuda: Requests to run heavy tasks outside the maintenance window. An Administrator or DBA authorizes them; whoever made the request can also authorize it, confirming with the second factor. The request expires after 24 h and the authorization after 2 h.
workarounds.autorizaciones.confirmar_mfa: Authorizing your own request requires confirming with the second factor. This device's biometrics are used or, if it is not registered, the Auth0 screen. Continue?
workarounds.automatizaciones.ayuda: Built-in remediations that run on their own when the event's alert fires. Every run is audited and Administrators and DBAs are notified. Setting it up for PROD (or for every connection) requires the second factor.
sandbox.subtitulo: Try queries and scripts on a copy of {instancia}'s structure in an isolated environment, with no data and no risk: everything is rolled back at the end.
sandbox.editor.eyebrow: T-SQL editor · batches separated by GO
sandbox.editor.placeholder: Type or paste the T-SQL to validate
sandbox.sintaxis_ok: Valid syntax: the batches compile against the Sandbox structure.
sandbox.aviso_estructura: Warning SBX_SNP_000: the Sandbox structure is more than 24 hours old or does not match the source. You should sync it.
sandbox.promover_nota: Administrator and DBA · requires second factor on PROD
sandbox.muestra.vacia: No rows: the Sandbox only has the structure, no data.
sandbox.historial.vacio: There are no Sandbox executions yet.
sandbox.promocion.analizando: Calculating the estimated plan on the real instance…
sandbox.promocion.ayuda: It runs on the real database inside a transaction: if anything fails, it is rolled back. It is recorded in the transactions audit log and Administrators and DBAs are notified.
sandbox.promocion.confirmar: Confirm and run on the instance
sandbox.promocion.confirmar_mfa: Promoting to PROD requires confirming with the second factor. This device's biometrics are used or, if it is not registered, the Auth0 screen. Continue?
sandbox.aviso.exitosa: {usuario} promoted a Sandbox-validated script on {base}: {filas} rows affected.
sandbox.aviso.fallida: The promotion by {usuario} on {base} failed and was rolled back: {error}
workarounds.validar.ayuda: Runs the steps of the current version in the Sandbox (against the instance structure, with no data and rolling back at the end). If it passes, that version is approved for PROD; if it fails, the previously approved version remains in effect.
workarounds.validar.ok: Validated in Sandbox: the current version is now approved for PROD.
workarounds.validar.sin_bases: This instance's Sandbox has no synced databases yet: sync it from Sandbox.
chat.subtitulo: Ask about the data in your databases. I'll take care of the T-SQL and of choosing where to run it.
chat.sin_conexiones: You have no enabled instances: ask an Administrator to enable the environment for you or to register a connection.
chat.confirmar_eliminar: Delete this conversation? Whatever was executed stays recorded in the log.
chat.vacio: Tell me what you need to know about your databases. You can start with one of these:
chat.ejemplo.1: How many orders were placed this month, by branch?
chat.ejemplo.2: Show me the 10 customers with the highest billing last quarter.
chat.ejemplo.3: Which products had no sales in the last 90 days?
chat.no_atendido.fuera: I only answer questions about the databases of your registered instances: their data, their structure or, depending on your role, the state of the engine.
chat.no_atendido.motor: Questions about the instance engine (sessions, errors, database state) are only for Administrators and DBAs. I can help you with the data in the databases.
chat.requiere_mfa: Running it requires confirming with the second factor.
chat.placeholder: Write your question the way you would ask a colleague, for example: "how many orders were cancelled last month by branch?"
chat.elige_base: The system chooses the database automatically
chat.columnas_enmascaradas: 🔒 Sensitive columns masked for your role (also in the CSV).
chat.sandbox_ok: Validated in Sandbox: {filas} rows in {ms} ms (rolled back). Promote it from there.
chat.confirmar_mfa: This operation requires confirming with the second factor. Continue?
chat.confirmar_advertencias: The operation breaks these business rules. Run it anyway?
chat.mod.INSERT_CONSULTA: I'm going to insert into {tabla} the records returned by a query.
chat.mod.estimado: Count calculated with the current data: it may change until you confirm.
chat.motivo.sandbox: This type of statement does not run directly: validate it in the Sandbox and promote it from there.
chat.motivo.motor: Queries about the instance engine are only for Administrators and DBAs.
chat.motivo.solo_lectura: Your role can only run read queries.
chat.motivo.solo_lectura_prod: In PROD your role can only run read queries: changes are made in DEV or TESTING.
chat.motivo.restringido: Your user is not allowed to change data in this environment.
chat.motivo.falta_where: Modifications need a WHERE that limits the rows.
chat.motivo.tabla_restringida: Your role does not have access to one of the sensitive tables involved.
chat.motivo.regla: A business rule blocks this operation.
contexto.subtitulo: The AI engine uses this context to translate your queries accurately for your business domain.
contexto.sin_conexiones: There are no connections registered yet. An Administrator or DBA can register them from Connections.
contexto.documentos.ayuda: Functional or non-functional company documents. The AI converts them to Markdown, writes a data-oriented summary and proposes terms and rules. The summary is what AI Chat and Best Practices use.
contexto.documentos.resumen_ayuda: This is what the AI receives in every query. Correct it if anything is inaccurate.
contexto.documentos.resumiendo: The AI is interpreting the document (summary, tables and proposals). This updates on its own.
contexto.documentos.confirmar_regenerar: The document will be interpreted again: summary corrections are lost and pending proposals are replaced. Continue?
contexto.documentos.error_resumen: The document could not be interpreted ({codigo}). Try interpreting it again.
contexto.documentos.interrumpido: The interpretation was interrupted. Try interpreting it again.
contexto.documentos.vacio: There are no documents for this database yet.
contexto.documentos.nota: PDF with text, up to 10 MB. Linked to the {base} database.
contexto.documentos.propuestas_ayuda: The AI suggests these terms and rules based on the document. Once accepted they move to the Glossary or Operational rules, where they can be edited.
contexto.documentos.propuestas_solo_admi: An Administrator or a DBA accepts them.
contexto.sensibles.eyebrow: Tables with access rules · double confirmation / masking
contexto.vacio: There are no items in this category yet. Add the first one with the button above.
contexto.form.roles_ven: Roles that see the columns unmasked
contexto.form.doble_confirmacion: Double confirmation (second factor) to modify it
contexto.form.regla_ejemplo: Do not modify data in PROD outside business hours
contexto.form.franja_ayuda: Local time of each connection. With no time range it always applies; a range that spans midnight (18:00 to 09:00) covers outside business hours.
contexto.confirmar_eliminar: Delete this item from the context?
sandbox.promocion.mfa: Requires confirming with the second factor.
inicio.alertas_pendientes: There are {n} active alerts that need your attention.
inicio.promociones: {n} queries validated in Sandbox are pending promotion.
inicio.accion.chat.descripcion: AI chat · your question becomes T-SQL
inicio.accion.workarounds.descripcion: Release blocking sessions · Log shrink · Clear plan cache
inicio.alerta_pendiente: There is {n} active alert that needs your attention.
inicio.estado.detalle_operativo: No critical alerts or warnings open.
auditoria.subtitulo: Tamper-proof record of every operation run from the application on the instances: chat, Sandbox and remediations. Filterable and exportable to CSV or PDF for regulators.
auditoria.titulo.excepciones: Code errors and HTTP error responses
auditoria.vacio: No records for the selected filters. Widen the date range or remove a filter.
auditoria.limite: There are {registros} records and this format's limit is {limite}: narrow the filters.
schema.subtitulo: {n} versions recorded · one for every structure change run from the application on the business databases. Differences and comparison between versions.
schema.sin_conexiones: There are no connections registered yet. An Administrator or DBA can register them from Connections.
schema.ayuda_comparar: Choose one version to compare it with the current state, or two to compare them with each other.
schema.vacio: No changes recorded yet. A version is created every time a structure change is run from the application.
schema.sin_diff_detalle: The structure could not be read before or after the run: the DDL is recorded without differences.
monitor.backups.sin_lectura: The backup history (msdb) could not be read. Check the permissions of the connection's login.
monitor.backups.sin_historial: No backups recorded for this database.
monitor.jobs.agente_detenido: SQL Server Agent is stopped: jobs and scheduled backups are not running.
monitor.jobs.sin_lectura: The jobs (msdb) could not be read. Check the permissions of the connection's login.
monitor.jobs.sin_agente: The instance has no SQL Server Agent (for example, Express).
monitor.jobs.sin_historial: The job has no recorded runs yet.
monitor.qs.desactivado: Query Store is disabled on {base}: without it there is no history of queries or plans.
monitor.qs.solo_lectura: Query Store is read-only (for example, because it is full): it records no new data. Enable it again to give it more space.
monitor.qs.vacio: Query Store recorded no queries in this period.
bp.subtitulo: The system measures the database (queries, indexes, fragmentation and schema) and the AI engine proposes improvements with their T-SQL. Every suggestion is validated in the Sandbox before being applied.
bp.sin_conexiones: You have no enabled instances: ask an Administrator to enable the environment for you or to register a connection.
bp.nuevo.titulo: What do you want to review?
bp.tipo_ayuda.consultas: The most CPU-expensive queries in the database (sys.dm_exec_query_stats).
bp.tipo_ayuda.indices: Missing indexes detected by the optimizer.
bp.tipo_ayuda.fragmentacion: Fragmented indexes larger than 1,000 pages (lightweight scan).
bp.tipo_ayuda.esquema: Tables without a primary key, heaps, unindexed foreign keys and deprecated types.
bp.reglas.eyebrow: Team rules · checked by the AI engine
bp.reglas.ejemplo: Every table must have audit columns (created_at, created_by)
bp.informe.en_curso: Measuring the database and analyzing the findings… this may take a minute.
bp.sandbox_ok: Validated in the Sandbox (rolled back). It is applied when promoted.
bp.error.ia: We couldn't reach the AI engine. The measured data was saved; try the analysis again in a few minutes.
bp.error.metricas: We couldn't read the instance metrics. Check that the connection responds and try again.
perfil.subtitulo: Your details, language, sign-in security and the devices that receive notifications.
perfil.rol_admin: Your role and environments are set by an Administrator in the Admin Panel.
perfil.idioma_ayuda: It also sets the language of your email and push notifications.
perfil.contrasena_ayuda: Auth0 will email you a link to set a new one. The application never sees your password.
perfil.con_google: You sign in with your Google account: Google manages your password and its changes.
perfil.sin_contrasena: Your account does not use a password managed by the application.
perfil.sin_dispositivos: No device receives push notifications. Enable them from Alerts on each phone or browser.
perfil.biometria_ayuda: Register this phone or laptop to confirm PROD actions, DELETEs and sensitive tables with your fingerprint, face or PIN, without leaving the application. Sign-in still uses Auth0.
perfil.biometria_sin_soporte: This browser does not support passkeys.
perfil.passkey_agregada: Device registered: you can now confirm with biometrics.
perfil.passkey_confirmar_quitar: That device will no longer be able to confirm with biometrics. Continue?
perfil.passkey_confirmar_mfa: To register a device, first confirm your identity with the Auth0 second factor. Continue?
perfil.confirmar_quitar: That device will stop receiving notifications. Continue?
perfil.correo_enviado: We sent the password change email to {email}.
error.USR_VAL_006: The user was recently deactivated; they can be reactivated.
error.USR_VAL_007: The user has already signed in: no invitation is needed.
error.USR_VAL_008: Your account signs in with Google: Google manages the password.
error.USR_AUT_001: The second authentication factor is invalid or was not completed.
error.USR_AUT_005: The session expired or does not exist.
error.USR_AUT_007: The passkey could not be verified: please try again.
error.USR_AUT_003: The email has not been verified yet.
error.USR_AUT_004: The sign-in request expired or is invalid.
error.USR_PER_000: The role does not have permission for this action.
error.USR_PER_003: The permissions exceed those of the base role.
error.USR_PER_004: An Administrator cannot remove their own role or deactivate themselves.
error.USR_PER_005: At least one active Administrator must remain.
error.USR_PER_006: Your user is not allowed to perform this action in that environment.
error.CON_DB_000: Could not connect to the instance.
error.CON_DB_001: A connection with that alias already exists.
error.CON_DB_003: The connection to the instance was lost.
error.MNT_CFG_000: The critical threshold must be greater than the warning threshold.
error.MNT_CFG_001: The backup policy allows 1 to 744 hours for full backups and 5 to 1440 minutes for log backups.
error.MNT_VAL_000: The requested job, database or run was not found.
error.ALR_VAL_001: An alert with that name already exists.
error.ALR_VAL_002: The alert has already been acknowledged.
error.WKR_VAL_001: A remediation with that name already exists.
error.WKR_EJE_000: One of the remediation's steps failed.
error.WKR_EJE_001: The situation changed since the diagnosis; review it and confirm again.
error.WKR_EJE_003: The instance has no SQL Server Agent (for example, Express): the backup cannot be scheduled.
error.WKR_EJE_004: Choose a future date and time within the next 31 days (server time).
error.WKR_EJE_005: The database does not allow log backups: it uses the SIMPLE recovery model or has no full backup starting the chain yet.
error.WKR_EJE_006: Query Store requires SQL Server 2016 or later.
error.WKR_SBX_001: The remediation is not validated in Sandbox; it cannot run in PROD.
error.WKR_AMB_000: The remediation does not apply to that environment.
error.WKR_VEN_000: Outside the maintenance window: requires authorization from another user.
error.WKR_AUT_002: Only eligible built-in remediations can run automatically.
error.aviso.servidor: The server couldn't complete the operation. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, let the administrator know.
error.aviso.sin_conexion: There is no connection to the server. Check your network and try again.
bp.error.generico: Something went wrong during the analysis. Try again in a few minutes.
error.SBX_SNP_000: The Sandbox structure is more than 24 hours old or does not match the source.
error.SBX_SNP_001: The Sandbox does not have that database yet: sync it and try again.
error.SBX_PRM_000: Only a successful execution that has not been promoted can be promoted.
error.SQL_VAL_001: This type of statement does not run directly: validate it in the Sandbox and promote it.
error.SQL_VAL_002: UPDATE, DELETE and INSERT…SELECT require a WHERE.
error.SQL_LCK_000: There are open transactions or locks on the tables involved; try again later.
error.EXP_LIM_000: The volume exceeds the export limit: narrow the filters.
error.BPR_VAL_000: Report, suggestion or rule not found.
error.BPR_VAL_001: The suggestion has no T-SQL to apply.
error.IA_API_000: Communication error with the AI engine.
error.IA_TRA_000: The query could not be translated.
error.CTX_VAL_001: The operation involves a sensitive table: it requires confirming with the second factor.
error.CTX_VAL_003: Technical entity not found in the schema.
error.CTX_REG_000: A business rule blocks the operation.
error.CTX_REG_001: The operation breaks warning-level business rules: confirm to continue.
error.CTX_DOC_000: The file is not a valid PDF.
error.CTX_DOC_001: The PDF has no readable text (is it a scan?). Upload a version with text.

plataforma.subtitulo: Company onboarding by invitation, suspension and operators. Company data is not accessible from here.
plataforma.empresas.vacio: There are no companies yet. Invite the first one from the Invitations tab.
plataforma.empresas.confirmar_suspender: Suspend {empresa}? Its users won't be able to sign in and monitoring stops. No data is deleted.
plataforma.empresas.confirmar_reactivar: Reactivate {empresa}? Its users will be able to sign in again.
plataforma.invitar.eyebrow: New company · The link expires in 24 h
plataforma.invitar.titulo: Invite a company to sign up
plataforma.invitar.ayuda: The invitee will be their company's first Administrator. They open the link, confirm their email with a code and choose the name and address. The 24 h start when you send or copy the link.
plataforma.invitar.enviada: Invitation sent to {email}. It expires in 24 h.
plataforma.invitar.sin_correo: The invitation was created but the email could not be sent: share this link with {email}. It expires in 24 h.
plataforma.invitar.copiada: Link copied. It expires in 24 h and only works for the invited email.
plataforma.invitar.copiar_manual: Couldn't copy automatically: copy the link below. It expires in 24 h.
plataforma.invitaciones.confirmar_revoca: Revoke the invitation for {email}? The link stops working.
plataforma.operadores.eyebrow: Full platform access · Sign-in with second factor
plataforma.operadores.confirmar_baja: Remove {email}? They lose access to the console immediately.
plataforma.operadores.aviso_alta: {email} is now an operator: we emailed them the console address.
plataforma.operadores.aviso_sin_correo: {email} is now an operator, but the email could not be sent: share this console's address with them.
plataforma.correo.invitacion.asunto: Invitation to sign up your company on DBA Assistant
plataforma.correo.invitacion.cuerpo:
Hello,

{invitante} invited you to sign up your company on DBA Assistant. You will be its first Administrator.

Open this link, confirm your email ({email}) with the code we will send you, and choose your company's name and address:

{enlace}

The invitation expires in 24 hours and only works with this email.

If you weren't expecting this email, you can ignore it.
plataforma.correo.operador.asunto: Access to the DBA Assistant platform console
plataforma.correo.operador.cuerpo:
Hello,

{invitante} gave you operator access to the DBA Assistant platform console.

Sign in at {url} with your email ({email}), using Google or creating your password, and set up your second factor.
registro.email.ayuda: Enter the email your invitation was sent to. We'll send you a code to confirm it's yours.
registro.email.label: Invited email
registro.codigo.enviado: If {email} has a valid invitation, we sent it a 6-digit code. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
registro.codigo.label: Verification code
registro.datos.ayuda: Email confirmed: {email}. You'll be the company's first Administrator.
registro.datos.aviso: The address can't be changed later: it identifies the company across the platform.
registro.datos.ocupada: {direccion} is already taken: try another one.
registro.datos.invalida: Use 1 to 40 lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (not at the start or end). Some addresses are reserved.
registro.datos.fija: Address chosen when the setup started: it can't be changed.
registro.progreso.en_curso: We're setting up your company. It can take up to a minute; don't close this page.
registro.progreso.listo: Your company is ready. We're taking you to its address for your first sign-in.
registro.progreso.error: The setup couldn't finish. You can retry: it resumes where it stopped.
registro.progreso.interrumpido: The setup was interrupted. You can retry: it resumes where it stopped.
registro.cerrada.usada: This invitation was already used to sign up a company. Sign in from your company's address.
registro.cerrada.texto: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.

workarounds.integrado.kill_bloqueos.desc: Lists the sessions that block others and terminates the selected ones with KILL.
workarounds.integrado.shrink_log.descrip: Runs CHECKPOINT and shrinks the database log to the space in use plus a margin.
workarounds.integrado.rebuild_indices.de: REBUILD of indexes with fragmentation above 30% and at least 1000 pages.
UPDATE STATISTICS on statistics with more than 20% of rows modified.
workarounds.integrado.limpiar_plan_cache: Removes the cached plans of the selected database (does not affect the others).
workarounds.integrado.checkpoint.descrip: Runs CHECKPOINT on the selected database to write modified pages to disk.
workarounds.integrado.iniciar_servicio.d: Starts the engine service on the Windows server through WinRM when it is stopped.
workarounds.integrado.base_online.descri: Lists the databases that are unavailable and sets the selected one ONLINE, if it is OFFLINE.
workarounds.integrado.programar_backup_f: Schedules a full backup (COPY_ONLY, with CHECKSUM) of the chosen database as a SQL Server Agent job, by default at the start of the next maintenance window. It does not run right away.
workarounds.integrado.programar_backup_l: Schedules a transaction log backup of the chosen database as a SQL Server Agent job, by default at the start of the next maintenance window. It frees log space.
workarounds.integrado.reintentar_job.des: Lists the SQL Server Agent jobs with their last outcome and runs the chosen one again.
workarounds.integrado.iniciar_agente.des: Starts the SQL Server Agent service on the Windows server through WinRM when it is stopped.
workarounds.integrado.activar_query_stor: Enables Query Store on the chosen database (read-write, automatic capture, 30 days) to keep the history of queries and their plans.
bp.hallazgo.consulta_regresion: Query that regressed or changed plan in the last 24 h (Query Store)
bp.hallazgo.indice_faltante: Missing index suggested by the optimizer
bp.hallazgo.sin_pk_ni_clustered: Table without a primary key or clustered index
bp.hallazgo.heap: Heap table: the primary key is not clustered
bp.hallazgo.fk_sin_indice: Foreign key {fk} without an index on {columna}
soporte.subtitulo: Service health, queues, application logs, system events and the application's internal database.
soporte.colas.sin_datos: The queue has not started yet.
soporte.colas.nota: Counters since this backend replica last started.
soporte.historia.subtitulo: Structure and data of DBA Assistant's own database. Changes to your customers' databases are in Schema history.
soporte.operador.subtitulo: Service status and application errors. No company data, logs or records are shown.
soporte.operador.aviso.texto: You're in {empresa} as a platform operator, read-only and for 1 hour. The access was recorded in the company's audit log and its Administrators were notified.
soporte.operador.correo.asunto: Support access to {empresa} on DBA Assistant
soporte.operador.correo.cuerpo:
Hello,

{operador}, a DBA Assistant platform operator, accessed {empresa} to provide support.

The access is read-only, lasts {minutos} minutes and only shows service status and application errors, with no company data or records. It was recorded in the audit log.

If you weren't expecting this access, contact DBA Assistant support.
soporte.errores.eyebrow: Last 7 days · Up to 100 · No company data
soporte.errores.ayuda: Only code errors and 5xx responses: the route as a template, the error code, the exception type and its location in the code. No users, IPs, messages or values.
soporte.errores.sin_traza: No trace in the application code.
soporte.errores.vacio: There were no application errors in the last 7 days.
plataforma.empresas.entrar_soporte: Enter as support (read-only; asks for the second factor)
plataforma.empresas.ayuda_soporte: Click an active company's address to enter as support: the second factor is required, the session lasts 1 hour and only shows service status and application errors. Its Administrators are notified.
soporte.estructura.vacio: No versions yet: the first one is taken when the backend starts.
soporte.estructura.inicial_detalle: First structure capture: the baseline for the next ones. Download the script to see every object.
soporte.estructura.sin_cambios: The structure has not changed since the last version.
soporte.ddl.buscar: Search event, object, login or program
soporte.ddl.nota: Includes changes made outside the application (for example, from SSMS).
soporte.datos.modo_momento: As it was at a point in time
soporte.datos.nota: SQL Server keeps the previous versions of each row. Passwords are never shown. The key filters by the first primary key column.
soporte.datos.resumen_cambios: {n} versions, newest first (greyed out: no longer current)
